entries.name: LeanP1.Channel
entries.statement: Type u_1 → (Y : Type u_2) → [Fintype Y] → Type (max u_1 u_2)

entries.name: LeanP1.Dist
entries.statement: (α : Type u_1) → [Fintype α] → Type u_1

entries.name: LeanP1.add_comm'
entries.statement: ∀ (a b : ℕ), a + b = b + a

entries.name: Real.negMulLog_le_of_pos
entries.statement: ∀ {a b : ℝ}, 0 ≤ a → 0 < b → a.negMulLog ≤ -a * Real.log b + b - a

entries.name: Real.negMulLog_le_sub_mul_log
entries.statement: ∀ {a b c : ℝ}, 0 ≤ a → 0 ≤ b → 0 ≤ c → a ≤ b → a ≤ c → a.negMulLog ≤ -a * Real.log b - a * Real.log c + b * c - a

entries.name: Real.negMulLog_sum_le
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_3} (s : Finset ι) (a : ι → ℝ), (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ a i) → (∑ i ∈ s, a i).negMulLog ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, (a i).negMulLog

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.Code
entries.statement: Type u_3 → Type u_4 → ℕ → ℕ → Type (max u_3 u_4)

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.IsAchievable
entries.statement: {X : Type u_1} → {Y : Type u_2} → [inst : Fintype Y] → LeanP1.Channel X Y → ℝ → Prop

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.bddAbove_range_mutualInfo
entries.statement: ∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype X] [inst_1 : Fintype Y] (W : LeanP1.Channel X Y), BddAbove (Set.range W.mutualInfo)

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.bsc
entries.statement: (ε : ℝ) → 0 ≤ ε → ε ≤ 1 → LeanP1.Channel Bool Bool

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.bsc_condEntropy
entries.statement: ∀ {ε : ℝ} (h0 : 0 ≤ ε) (h1 : ε ≤ 1) (p : LeanP1.Dist Bool), (LeanP1.Channel.bsc ε h0 h1).condEntropy p = Real.binEntropy ε

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.bsc_entropy
entries.statement: ∀ {ε : ℝ} (h0 : 0 ≤ ε) (h1 : ε ≤ 1) (x : Bool), (LeanP1.Channel.bsc ε h0 h1 x).entropy = Real.binEntropy ε

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.bsc_mutualInfo_le
entries.statement: ∀ {ε : ℝ} (h0 : 0 ≤ ε) (h1 : ε ≤ 1) (p : LeanP1.Dist Bool), (LeanP1.Channel.bsc ε h0 h1).mutualInfo p ≤ Real.log 2 - Real.binEntropy ε

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.bsc_mutualInfo_uniform
entries.statement: ∀ {ε : ℝ} (h0 : 0 ≤ ε) (h1 : ε ≤ 1), (LeanP1.Channel.bsc ε h0 h1).mutualInfo LeanP1.Dist.uniform = Real.log 2 - Real.binEntropy ε

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.bsc_output_uniform
entries.statement: ∀ {ε : ℝ} (h0 : 0 ≤ ε) (h1 : ε ≤ 1), (LeanP1.Channel.bsc ε h0 h1).output LeanP1.Dist.uniform = LeanP1.Dist.uniform

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.capacity
entries.statement: {X : Type u_1} → {Y : Type u_2} → [Fintype X] → [inst : Fintype Y] → LeanP1.Channel X Y → ℝ

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.capacity_bsc
entries.statement: ∀ {ε : ℝ} (h0 : 0 ≤ ε) (h1 : ε ≤ 1), (LeanP1.Channel.bsc ε h0 h1).capacity = Real.log 2 - Real.binEntropy ε

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.capacity_le
entries.statement: ∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype X] [inst_1 : Fintype Y] [Nonempty X] {W : LeanP1.Channel X Y} {C : ℝ}, (∀ (p : LeanP1.Dist X), W.mutualInfo p ≤ C) → W.capacity ≤ C

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.capacity_le_log_card
entries.statement: ∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype X] [inst_1 : Fintype Y] [Nonempty X] (W : LeanP1.Channel X Y), W.capacity ≤ Real.log ↑(Fintype.card Y)

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.capacity_le_log_card_input
entries.statement: ∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype X] [inst_1 : Fintype Y] [Nonempty X] (W : LeanP1.Channel X Y), W.capacity ≤ Real.log ↑(Fintype.card X)

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.capacity_nonneg
entries.statement: ∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype X] [inst_1 : Fintype Y] [Nonempty X] (W : LeanP1.Channel X Y), 0 ≤ W.capacity

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.capacity_pow_le
entries.statement: ∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype Y] [inst_1 : Fintype X] [Nonempty X] (W : LeanP1.Channel X Y) (n : ℕ), (W.pow n).capacity ≤ ↑n * W.capacity

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.capacity_prod_le
entries.statement: ∀ {X₁ : Type u_1} {X₂ : Type u_2} {Y₁ : Type u_3} {Y₂ : Type u_4} [inst : Fintype Y₁] [inst_1 : Fintype Y₂] [inst_2 : Fintype X₁] [inst_3 : Fintype X₂] [Nonempty X₁] [Nonempty X₂] (W₁ : LeanP1.Channel X₁ Y₁) (W₂ : LeanP1.Channel X₂ Y₂), (W₁.prod W₂).capacity ≤ W₁.capacity + W₂.capacity

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.condEntropy
entries.statement: {X : Type u_1} → {Y : Type u_2} → [inst : Fintype X] → [inst_1 : Fintype Y] → LeanP1.Channel X Y → LeanP1.Dist X → ℝ

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.condEntropy_comp
entries.statement: ∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} {Z : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype X] [inst_1 : Fintype Y] [inst_2 : Fintype Z] [inst_3 : DecidableEq X] (W : LeanP1.Channel X Y) (f : Z → X) (p : LeanP1.Dist Z), LeanP1.Channel.condEntropy (fun z => W (f z)) p = W.condEntropy (LeanP1.Dist.map f p)

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.condEntropy_le_entropy_output
entries.statement: ∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype X] [inst_1 : Fintype Y] (W : LeanP1.Channel X Y) (p : LeanP1.Dist X), W.condEntropy p ≤ (W.output p).entropy

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.condEntropy_le_log_card
entries.statement: ∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype X] [inst_1 : Fintype Y] (W : LeanP1.Channel X Y) (p : LeanP1.Dist X), W.condEntropy p ≤ Real.log ↑(Fintype.card Y)

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.condEntropy_mapOutput
entries.statement: ∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} {Y' : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype X] [inst_1 : Fintype Y] [inst_2 : Fintype Y'] [inst_3 : DecidableEq Y'] (σ : Y ≃ Y') (W : LeanP1.Channel X Y) (p : LeanP1.Dist X), (LeanP1.Channel.mapOutput σ W).condEntropy p = W.condEntropy p

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.condEntropy_nonneg
entries.statement: ∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype X] [inst_1 : Fintype Y] (W : LeanP1.Channel X Y) (p : LeanP1.Dist X), 0 ≤ W.condEntropy p

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.condEntropy_prod
entries.statement: ∀ {X₁ : Type u_1} {X₂ : Type u_2} {Y₁ : Type u_3} {Y₂ : Type u_4} [inst : Fintype Y₁] [inst_1 : Fintype Y₂] [inst_2 : Fintype X₁] [inst_3 : Fintype X₂] (W₁ : LeanP1.Channel X₁ Y₁) (W₂ : LeanP1.Channel X₂ Y₂) (p : LeanP1.Dist (X₁ × X₂)), (W₁.prod W₂).condEntropy p = LeanP1.Channel.condEntropy (fun x => W₁ x.1) p + LeanP1.Channel.condEntropy (fun x => W₂ x.2) p

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.entropy_joint
entries.statement: ∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype X] [inst_1 : Fintype Y] (W : LeanP1.Channel X Y) (p : LeanP1.Dist X), (W.joint p).entropy = p.entropy + W.condEntropy p

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.entropy_output_le_entropy_joint
entries.statement: ∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype X] [inst_1 : Fintype Y] (W : LeanP1.Channel X Y) (p : LeanP1.Dist X), (W.output p).entropy ≤ (W.joint p).entropy

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.finSuccSplit
entries.statement: (α : Type u_1) → (n : ℕ) → (Fin (n + 1) → α) ≃ α × (Fin n → α)

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.finSuccSplit_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {n : ℕ} (f : Fin (n + 1) → α), (LeanP1.Channel.finSuccSplit α n) f = (f 0, fun i => f i.succ)

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.instNonemptyFinOfNeZeroNat
entries.statement: ∀ {M : ℕ} [NeZero M], Nonempty (Fin M)

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.isAchievable_of_lt_capacity
entries.statement: ∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype Y] [inst_1 : Fintype X] (W : LeanP1.Channel X Y) {R : ℝ}, R < W.capacity → W.IsAchievable R

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.isAchievable_of_nonpos
entries.statement: ∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype Y] [Nonempty X] (W : LeanP1.Channel X Y) {R : ℝ}, R ≤ 0 → W.IsAchievable R

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.joint
entries.statement: {X : Type u_1} → {Y : Type u_2} → [inst : Fintype X] → [inst_1 : Fintype Y] → LeanP1.Channel X Y → LeanP1.Dist X → LeanP1.Dist (X × Y)

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.joint_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype X] [inst_1 : Fintype Y] (W : LeanP1.Channel X Y) (p : LeanP1.Dist X) (xy : X × Y), (W.joint p).pmf xy = p.pmf xy.1 * (W xy.1).pmf xy.2

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.le_capacity
entries.statement: ∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype X] [inst_1 : Fintype Y] {W : LeanP1.Channel X Y} {C : ℝ} (p : LeanP1.Dist X), C ≤ W.mutualInfo p → C ≤ W.capacity

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.mapOutput
entries.statement: {X : Type u_1} → {Y : Type u_2} → {Y' : Type u_3} → [inst : Fintype Y] → [inst_1 : Fintype Y'] → [DecidableEq Y'] → Y ≃ Y' → LeanP1.Channel X Y → LeanP1.Channel X Y'

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.map_fst_output_prod
entries.statement: ∀ {X₁ : Type u_1} {X₂ : Type u_2} {Y₁ : Type u_3} {Y₂ : Type u_4} [inst : Fintype Y₁] [inst_1 : Fintype Y₂] [inst_2 : Fintype X₁] [inst_3 : Fintype X₂] [inst_4 : DecidableEq Y₁] (W₁ : LeanP1.Channel X₁ Y₁) (W₂ : LeanP1.Channel X₂ Y₂) (p : LeanP1.Dist (X₁ × X₂)), LeanP1.Dist.map Prod.fst ((W₁.prod W₂).output p) = LeanP1.Channel.output (fun x => W₁ x.1) p

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.map_snd_output_prod
entries.statement: ∀ {X₁ : Type u_1} {X₂ : Type u_2} {Y₁ : Type u_3} {Y₂ : Type u_4} [inst : Fintype Y₁] [inst_1 : Fintype Y₂] [inst_2 : Fintype X₁] [inst_3 : Fintype X₂] [inst_4 : DecidableEq Y₂] (W₁ : LeanP1.Channel X₁ Y₁) (W₂ : LeanP1.Channel X₂ Y₂) (p : LeanP1.Dist (X₁ × X₂)), LeanP1.Dist.map Prod.snd ((W₁.prod W₂).output p) = LeanP1.Channel.output (fun x => W₂ x.2) p

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.mutualInfo
entries.statement: {X : Type u_1} → {Y : Type u_2} → [inst : Fintype X] → [inst_1 : Fintype Y] → LeanP1.Channel X Y → LeanP1.Dist X → ℝ

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.mutualInfo_comp
entries.statement: ∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} {Z : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype X] [inst_1 : Fintype Y] [inst_2 : Fintype Z] [inst_3 : DecidableEq X] (W : LeanP1.Channel X Y) (f : Z → X) (p : LeanP1.Dist Z), LeanP1.Channel.mutualInfo (fun z => W (f z)) p = W.mutualInfo (LeanP1.Dist.map f p)

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.mutualInfo_comp_le_capacity
entries.statement: ∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype X] [inst_1 : Fintype Y] {Z : Type u_3} [inst_2 : Fintype Z] (W : LeanP1.Channel X Y) (f : Z → X) (p : LeanP1.Dist Z), LeanP1.Channel.mutualInfo (fun z => W (f z)) p ≤ W.capacity

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.mutualInfo_eq_add_sub
entries.statement: ∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype X] [inst_1 : Fintype Y] (W : LeanP1.Channel X Y) (p : LeanP1.Dist X), W.mutualInfo p = p.entropy + (W.output p).entropy - (W.joint p).entropy

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.mutualInfo_le_capacity
entries.statement: ∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype X] [inst_1 : Fintype Y] (W : LeanP1.Channel X Y) (p : LeanP1.Dist X), W.mutualInfo p ≤ W.capacity

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.mutualInfo_le_entropy
entries.statement: ∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype X] [inst_1 : Fintype Y] (W : LeanP1.Channel X Y) (p : LeanP1.Dist X), W.mutualInfo p ≤ p.entropy

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.mutualInfo_le_entropy_output
entries.statement: ∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype X] [inst_1 : Fintype Y] (W : LeanP1.Channel X Y) (p : LeanP1.Dist X), W.mutualInfo p ≤ (W.output p).entropy

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.mutualInfo_le_log_card
entries.statement: ∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype X] [inst_1 : Fintype Y] (W : LeanP1.Channel X Y) (p : LeanP1.Dist X), W.mutualInfo p ≤ Real.log ↑(Fintype.card Y)

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.mutualInfo_le_log_card_input
entries.statement: ∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype X] [inst_1 : Fintype Y] (W : LeanP1.Channel X Y) (p : LeanP1.Dist X), W.mutualInfo p ≤ Real.log ↑(Fintype.card X)

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.mutualInfo_mapOutput
entries.statement: ∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} {Y' : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype X] [inst_1 : Fintype Y] [inst_2 : Fintype Y'] [inst_3 : DecidableEq Y'] (σ : Y ≃ Y') (W : LeanP1.Channel X Y) (p : LeanP1.Dist X), (LeanP1.Channel.mapOutput σ W).mutualInfo p = W.mutualInfo p

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.mutualInfo_nonneg
entries.statement: ∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype X] [inst_1 : Fintype Y] (W : LeanP1.Channel X Y) (p : LeanP1.Dist X), 0 ≤ W.mutualInfo p

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.mutualInfo_prod_le
entries.statement: ∀ {X₁ : Type u_1} {X₂ : Type u_2} {Y₁ : Type u_3} {Y₂ : Type u_4} [inst : Fintype Y₁] [inst_1 : Fintype Y₂] [inst_2 : Fintype X₁] [inst_3 : Fintype X₂] [inst_4 : DecidableEq X₁] [inst_5 : DecidableEq X₂] (W₁ : LeanP1.Channel X₁ Y₁) (W₂ : LeanP1.Channel X₂ Y₂) (p : LeanP1.Dist (X₁ × X₂)), (W₁.prod W₂).mutualInfo p ≤ W₁.mutualInfo (LeanP1.Dist.map Prod.fst p) + W₂.mutualInfo (LeanP1.Dist.map Prod.snd p)

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.operationalCapacity
entries.statement: {X : Type u_1} → {Y : Type u_2} → [inst : Fintype Y] → LeanP1.Channel X Y → ℝ

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.operationalCapacity_eq_capacity
entries.statement: ∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype X] [inst_1 : Fintype Y] [Nonempty X] (W : LeanP1.Channel X Y), W.operationalCapacity = W.capacity

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.output
entries.statement: {X : Type u_1} → {Y : Type u_2} → [inst : Fintype Y] → [inst_1 : Fintype X] → LeanP1.Channel X Y → LeanP1.Dist X → LeanP1.Dist Y

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.output_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype Y] [inst_1 : Fintype X] (W : LeanP1.Channel X Y) (p : LeanP1.Dist X) (y : Y), (W.output p).pmf y = ∑ x, p.pmf x * (W x).pmf y

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.output_comp
entries.statement: ∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} {Z : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype X] [inst_1 : Fintype Y] [inst_2 : Fintype Z] [inst_3 : DecidableEq X] (W : LeanP1.Channel X Y) (f : Z → X) (p : LeanP1.Dist Z), LeanP1.Channel.output (fun z => W (f z)) p = W.output (LeanP1.Dist.map f p)

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.output_mapOutput
entries.statement: ∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} {Y' : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype X] [inst_1 : Fintype Y] [inst_2 : Fintype Y'] [inst_3 : DecidableEq Y'] (σ : Y ≃ Y') (W : LeanP1.Channel X Y) (p : LeanP1.Dist X), (LeanP1.Channel.mapOutput σ W).output p = LeanP1.Dist.map (⇑σ) (W.output p)

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.pow
entries.statement: {X : Type u_1} → {Y : Type u_2} → [inst : Fintype Y] → LeanP1.Channel X Y → (n : ℕ) → LeanP1.Channel (Fin n → X) (Fin n → Y)

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.pow_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype Y] (W : LeanP1.Channel X Y) (n : ℕ) (x : Fin n → X) (y : Fin n → Y), (W.pow n x).pmf y = ∏ i, (W (x i)).pmf (y i)

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.pow_succ_eq
entries.statement: ∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype Y] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Y] (W : LeanP1.Channel X Y) (n : ℕ), W.pow (n + 1) = fun x => LeanP1.Channel.mapOutput (LeanP1.Channel.finSuccSplit Y n).symm (W.prod (W.pow n)) ((LeanP1.Channel.finSuccSplit X n) x)

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.prod
entries.statement: {X₁ : Type u_1} → {X₂ : Type u_2} → {Y₁ : Type u_3} → {Y₂ : Type u_4} → [inst : Fintype Y₁] → [inst_1 : Fintype Y₂] → LeanP1.Channel X₁ Y₁ → LeanP1.Channel X₂ Y₂ → LeanP1.Channel (X₁ × X₂) (Y₁ × Y₂)

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.prod_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {X₁ : Type u_1} {X₂ : Type u_2} {Y₁ : Type u_3} {Y₂ : Type u_4} [inst : Fintype Y₁] [inst_1 : Fintype Y₂] (W₁ : LeanP1.Channel X₁ Y₁) (W₂ : LeanP1.Channel X₂ Y₂) (x : X₁ × X₂) (y : Y₁ × Y₂), (W₁.prod W₂ x).pmf y = (W₁ x.1).pmf y.1 * (W₂ x.2).pmf y.2

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.rate
entries.statement: ℕ → ℕ → ℝ

entries.name: LeanP1.Dist.bernoulli
entries.statement: (q : ℝ) → 0 ≤ q → q ≤ 1 → LeanP1.Dist Bool

entries.name: LeanP1.Dist.bernoulli_false
entries.statement: ∀ {q : ℝ} (h0 : 0 ≤ q) (h1 : q ≤ 1), (LeanP1.Dist.bernoulli q h0 h1).pmf false = 1 - q

entries.name: LeanP1.Dist.bernoulli_true
entries.statement: ∀ {q : ℝ} (h0 : 0 ≤ q) (h1 : q ≤ 1), (LeanP1.Dist.bernoulli q h0 h1).pmf true = q

entries.statement: {α : Type u_1} → [inst : Fintype α] → LeanP1.Dist α → ℝ

entries.name: LeanP1.Dist.entropy_bernoulli
entries.statement: ∀ {q : ℝ} (h0 : 0 ≤ q) (h1 : q ≤ 1), (LeanP1.Dist.bernoulli q h0 h1).entropy = Real.binEntropy q

entries.name: LeanP1.Dist.entropy_le_entropy_map_fst_add_map_snd
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype α] [inst_1 : Fintype β] [inst_2 : DecidableEq α] [inst_3 : DecidableEq β] (r : LeanP1.Dist (α × β)), r.entropy ≤ (LeanP1.Dist.map Prod.fst r).entropy + (LeanP1.Dist.map Prod.snd r).entropy

entries.name: LeanP1.Dist.entropy_le_log_card
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] (p : LeanP1.Dist α), p.entropy ≤ Real.log ↑(Fintype.card α)

entries.name: LeanP1.Dist.entropy_map_equiv
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype α] [inst_1 : Fintype β] [inst_2 : DecidableEq β] (σ : α ≃ β) (p : LeanP1.Dist α), (LeanP1.Dist.map (⇑σ) p).entropy = p.entropy

entries.name: LeanP1.Dist.entropy_nonneg
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] (p : LeanP1.Dist α), 0 ≤ p.entropy

entries.name: LeanP1.Dist.entropy_prod
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype α] [inst_1 : Fintype β] (p : LeanP1.Dist α) (q : LeanP1.Dist β), (p.prod q).entropy = p.entropy + q.entropy

entries.name: LeanP1.Dist.entropy_pure
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] [inst_1 : DecidableEq α] (a : α), (LeanP1.Dist.pure a).entropy = 0

entries.name: LeanP1.Dist.entropy_uniform
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] [inst_1 : Nonempty α], LeanP1.Dist.uniform.entropy = Real.log ↑(Fintype.card α)

entries.name: LeanP1.Dist.exists_pos
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] (p : LeanP1.Dist α), ∃ a, 0 < p.pmf a

entries.name: LeanP1.Dist.ext
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] {p q : LeanP1.Dist α}, (∀ (a : α), p.pmf a = q.pmf a) → p = q

entries.name: LeanP1.Dist.instCoeFunForallReal
entries.statement: {α : Type u_1} → [inst : Fintype α] → CoeFun (LeanP1.Dist α) fun x => α → ℝ

entries.name: LeanP1.Dist.le_one
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] (p : LeanP1.Dist α) (a : α), p.pmf a ≤ 1

entries.name: LeanP1.Dist.map
entries.statement: {α : Type u_1} → {β : Type u_2} → [inst : Fintype α] → [inst_1 : Fintype β] → [DecidableEq β] → (α → β) → LeanP1.Dist α → LeanP1.Dist β

entries.name: LeanP1.Dist.map_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype α] [inst_1 : Fintype β] [inst_2 : DecidableEq β] (f : α → β) (p : LeanP1.Dist α) (b : β), (LeanP1.Dist.map f p).pmf b = ∑ a, if f a = b then p.pmf a else 0

entries.name: LeanP1.Dist.map_equiv_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype α] [inst_1 : Fintype β] [inst_2 : DecidableEq β] (σ : α ≃ β) (p : LeanP1.Dist α) (b : β), (LeanP1.Dist.map (⇑σ) p).pmf b = p.pmf (σ.symm b)

entries.name: LeanP1.Dist.map_fst_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype α] [inst_1 : Fintype β] [inst_2 : DecidableEq α] (r : LeanP1.Dist (α × β)) (a : α), (LeanP1.Dist.map Prod.fst r).pmf a = ∑ b, r.pmf (a, b)

entries.name: LeanP1.Dist.map_snd_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype α] [inst_1 : Fintype β] [inst_2 : DecidableEq β] (r : LeanP1.Dist (α × β)) (b : β), (LeanP1.Dist.map Prod.snd r).pmf b = ∑ a, r.pmf (a, b)

entries.name: LeanP1.Dist.nonempty
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] (p : LeanP1.Dist α), Nonempty α

entries.name: LeanP1.Dist.pi
entries.statement: {ι : Type u_1} → [inst : Fintype ι] → [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] → {β : ι → Type u_2} → [inst_2 : (i : ι) → Fintype (β i)] → ((i : ι) → LeanP1.Dist (β i)) → LeanP1.Dist ((i : ι) → β i)

entries.name: LeanP1.Dist.pi_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] {β : ι → Type u_2} [inst_2 : (i : ι) → Fintype (β i)] (p : (i : ι) → LeanP1.Dist (β i)) (b : (i : ι) → β i), (LeanP1.Dist.pi p).pmf b = ∏ i, (p i).pmf (b i)

entries.name: LeanP1.Dist.pmf_eq_coe
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] (p : LeanP1.Dist α) (a : α), p.pmf a = p.pmf a

entries.name: LeanP1.Dist.prod
entries.statement: {α : Type u_1} → {β : Type u_2} → [inst : Fintype α] → [inst_1 : Fintype β] → LeanP1.Dist α → LeanP1.Dist β → LeanP1.Dist (α × β)

entries.name: LeanP1.Dist.prod_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype α] [inst_1 : Fintype β] (p : LeanP1.Dist α) (q : LeanP1.Dist β) (ab : α × β), (p.prod q).pmf ab = p.pmf ab.1 * q.pmf ab.2

entries.name: LeanP1.Dist.pure
entries.statement: {α : Type u_1} → [inst : Fintype α] → [DecidableEq α] → α → LeanP1.Dist α

entries.name: LeanP1.Dist.pure_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] [inst_1 : DecidableEq α] (a b : α), (LeanP1.Dist.pure a).pmf b = if b = a then 1 else 0

entries.name: LeanP1.Dist.pure_apply_ne
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] [inst_1 : DecidableEq α] {a b : α}, b ≠ a → (LeanP1.Dist.pure a).pmf b = 0

entries.name: LeanP1.Dist.pure_apply_self
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] [inst_1 : DecidableEq α] (a : α), (LeanP1.Dist.pure a).pmf a = 1

entries.name: LeanP1.Dist.sum_coe
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] (p : LeanP1.Dist α), ∑ a, p.pmf a = 1

entries.name: LeanP1.Dist.uniform
entries.statement: {α : Type u_1} → [inst : Fintype α] → [Nonempty α] → LeanP1.Dist α

entries.name: LeanP1.Dist.uniform_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] [inst_1 : Nonempty α] (a : α), LeanP1.Dist.uniform.pmf a = (↑(Fintype.card α))⁻¹

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.Code.avgError_le_maxError
entries.statement: ∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype Y] {n M : ℕ} [NeZero M] (W : LeanP1.Channel X Y) (c : LeanP1.Channel.Code X Y n M), LeanP1.Channel.Code.avgError W c ≤ LeanP1.Channel.Code.maxError W c

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.Code.avgError_nonneg
entries.statement: ∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype Y] {n M : ℕ} (W : LeanP1.Channel X Y) (c : LeanP1.Channel.Code X Y n M), 0 ≤ LeanP1.Channel.Code.avgError W c

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.Code.errorProb
entries.statement: {X : Type u_1} → {Y : Type u_2} → [inst : Fintype Y] → {n M : ℕ} → LeanP1.Channel X Y → LeanP1.Channel.Code X Y n M → Fin M → ℝ

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.Code.errorProb_le_maxError
entries.statement: ∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype Y] {n M : ℕ} (W : LeanP1.Channel X Y) (c : LeanP1.Channel.Code X Y n M) (m : Fin M), LeanP1.Channel.Code.errorProb W c m ≤ LeanP1.Channel.Code.maxError W c

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.Code.errorProb_le_one
entries.statement: ∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype Y] {n M : ℕ} (W : LeanP1.Channel X Y) (c : LeanP1.Channel.Code X Y n M) (m : Fin M), LeanP1.Channel.Code.errorProb W c m ≤ 1

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.Code.errorProb_nonneg
entries.statement: ∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype Y] {n M : ℕ} (W : LeanP1.Channel X Y) (c : LeanP1.Channel.Code X Y n M) (m : Fin M), 0 ≤ LeanP1.Channel.Code.errorProb W c m

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.Code.fano
entries.statement: ∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype Y] {n M : ℕ} [inst_1 : NeZero M] (W : LeanP1.Channel X Y) (c : LeanP1.Channel.Code X Y n M), Real.log ↑M - (LeanP1.Channel.Code.msgChannel W c).mutualInfo LeanP1.Dist.uniform ≤ Real.log 2 + LeanP1.Channel.Code.avgError W c * Real.log ↑M

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.Code.log_card_mul_one_sub_avgError_le
entries.statement: ∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype Y] {n M : ℕ} [inst_1 : Fintype X] [NeZero M] (W : LeanP1.Channel X Y) (c : LeanP1.Channel.Code X Y n M), Real.log ↑M * (1 - LeanP1.Channel.Code.avgError W c) ≤ (W.pow n).capacity + Real.log 2

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.Code.maxError_le_one
entries.statement: ∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype Y] {n M : ℕ} (W : LeanP1.Channel X Y) (c : LeanP1.Channel.Code X Y n M), LeanP1.Channel.Code.maxError W c ≤ 1

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.Code.maxError_nonneg
entries.statement: ∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype Y] {n M : ℕ} (W : LeanP1.Channel X Y) (c : LeanP1.Channel.Code X Y n M), 0 ≤ LeanP1.Channel.Code.maxError W c

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.Code.msgChannel_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype Y] {n M : ℕ} (W : LeanP1.Channel X Y) (c : LeanP1.Channel.Code X Y n M) (m : Fin M), LeanP1.Channel.Code.msgChannel W c m = W.pow n (c.enc m)

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.IsAchievable.le_capacity
entries.statement: ∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype X] [inst_1 : Fintype Y] [Nonempty X] {W : LeanP1.Channel X Y} {R : ℝ}, W.IsAchievable R → R ≤ W.capacity

entries.name: LeanP1.Channel.IsAchievable.mono
